status: first pass (roadmap L11, docs/scenery/TERRAIN_ROADMAP.md A.5 step 4 and decision D12)
notes: Land use following the ground in the hill country (simcore/terrain_map.hpp MapLandUseDef, read by LoadMap; the measures are the hills' bake's, LandformBake): woods on the steep sides and the crests, meadow on the wet valley floors and on slopes too steep to plough. The named forests, the copses and the fields of the plain are unchanged. Judged by eye against the look target (docs/scenery/LOOK_TARGET.md K2) and photographs of Transdanubian hill country (to be gathered); every value an estimate until sourced.

wood_slope_deg.source: game value: sam3d estimate (A.5: woods on slopes over about 10-12 degrees)

wood_slope_spread_deg.source: game value: sam3d estimate (so a wood's edge winds, not a contour)

min_relief_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (none where the hills fade into the plain)

meadow_wetness.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the wetness index of Beven and Kirkby 1979 on a valley floor; not read, the index's form only)

meadow_crop.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a crop of data/scenery/map_dressing.json)

max_grade_main.source: game value: sam3d estimate (A.5 step 5: main roads about 6%; to be sourced)

max_grade_road.source: game value: sam3d estimate (A.5 step 5: secondary roads about 8%; to be sourced)

max_grade_track.source: game value: sam3d estimate (A.5 step 5: tracks 12-15%; to be sourced)

max_grade_rail.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a main line through hills; to be sourced)

side_slope.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a cutting's or embankment's side, 1 in 1.5)

formation_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (shoulder and ditch each side)

brook_row_share.source: game value: sam3d estimate (of a brook's 100 m pieces, the share with alders on one bank; A.5 step 4: willows and alders along the brooks)

formation_min_half_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (half the core's 50 m ground cell, so a node falls on the formation)

lane_share.source: game value: sam3d estimate (of the steep climbs of the hills' farm tracks, the share worn into sunken lanes; to be judged against photographs of the Transdanubian loess hills)

lane_depth_m.source: degeeter_sunken_lanes (the mean depth of 132 lanes at their initiation point, 2.5 m; range 0.5-10 m)

lane_depth_spread.source: game value: sam3d estimate (depths drawn from half to twice the mean, 1.25-5 m, inside degeeter_sunken_lanes's range)

lane_floor_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the farm track's width, inside degeeter_sunken_lanes's bottom widths of 0.8-11 m, mean 2.3 m)

lane_bank_run.source: derived: degeeter_sunken_lanes's mean top width 10 m and bottom width 2.3 m at the mean depth 2.5 m give (10 - 2.3) / 2 / 2.5 = 1.54 m of bank per metre of depth

lane_min_rise_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a climb rising less is left a track; degeeter_sunken_lanes counts a lane from 0.5 m deep)

lane_grid_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the lanes' tiles of finer ground: 25 to the core's 50 m cell, so a bank of 2-7 m has nodes on it)

lane_row_share.source: game value: sam3d estimate (degeeter_sunken_lanes: the banks vegetated by shrubs and grasses)

pond_radius_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a village pond 25-40 m long, judged by eye against the look target's K-f; to be sourced)

pond_aspect.source: game value: sam3d estimate (long along the contour, as a dammed hollow)

pond_depth_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (a shallow village pond)

pond_drop_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the water below the lowest of its rim)

pond_shore_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (its bank's run from the water up to the ground round it)

pond_max_dam_m.source: game value: sam3d estimate (no village pond needing a higher dam)

pond_trees.source: game value: sam3d estimate (the look target's K-f: a willow by the pond; each a white willow since A.3.37)
